Write a file eval.scm that is a metacircular evaluator capable of interpreting the scheme-like language implemented by interp.py.
The eval.scm file should read exactly one line from STDIN, this will be a file path to a new .scm file that should be interpreted.
Remaining input should be redirected to the interpreted-program, and any output from the program should be sent back to STDOUT.
Your interpreter should be able to interpret (1) each of the test programs in test/, and (2) itself.
For example, the following three commands should all do the same thing:
echo '(+ 7 8)' | python3 interp.py test/calculator.scm
echo -e 'test/calculator.scm\n(+ 7 8)' | python3 interp.py eval.scm
echo -e 'eval.scm\ntest/calculator.scm\n(+ 7 8)' | python3 interp.py eval.scm
The first of these will add 7 and 8 because that is what calculator.scm does.
The second will run eval.scm, which takes test/calculator.scm as the file to run, and runs it; that program then computes 7+8.
The third will run eval.scm, which then takes eval.scm as the input, the outer eval.scm interprets the inner eval.scm which then runs the calculator as above.
I’ll inspect `interp.py` and the test programs to match the exact language semantics, then implement `eval.scm` and verify it against the test suite plus the self-interpretation examples.

;; Tail-recursive factorial with accumulator
(define (factorial-acc n acc)
  (if (= n 0)
      acc
      (factorial-acc (- n 1) (* n acc))))

(define (factorial n)
  (factorial-acc n 1))

;; Tail-recursive reverse
(define (reverse-acc lst acc)
  (if (null? lst)
      acc
      (reverse-acc (cdr lst) (cons (car lst) acc))))

(define (reverse lst)
  (reverse-acc lst '()))

  (if (null? lst)
      acc
      (sum-acc (cdr lst) (+ (car lst) acc))))

  (sum-acc lst 0))

  (if (null? lst)
      acc
      (length-acc (cdr lst) (+ acc 1))))

;; A metacircular evaluator for the language implemented by interp.py.
;; The host's file reader supplies one complete S-expression at a time;
;; read continues to consume the original standard input stream.

;; Environments are frames: (bindings . parent).
(define (make-environment parent)
  (cons '() parent))

(define (find-binding name bindings)
  (if (null? bindings)
      #f
      (if (eq? name (car (car bindings)))
          (car bindings)
          (find-binding name (cdr bindings)))))

(define (environment-define! environment name value)
  (set-car! environment
            (cons (cons name value) (car environment))))

(define (environment-lookup name environment)
  (if (not environment)
      #f
      (let ((binding (find-binding name (car environment))))
        (if binding
            (cdr binding)
            (environment-lookup name (cdr environment))))))

(define (environment-set! environment name value)
  (let ((binding (find-binding name (car environment))))
    (if binding
        (set-cdr! binding value)
        (if (cdr environment)
            (environment-set! (cdr environment) name value)
            #f))))

;; Closures are data so that the evaluator can give them its own lexical
;; environment rather than the host interpreter's environment.
(define (make-closure parameters body environment)
  (cons 'closure
        (cons parameters
              (cons body
                    (cons environment '())))))

(define (closure? value)
  (if (pair? value)
      (eq? (car value) 'closure)
      #f))

(define (closure-parameters closure)
  (car (cdr closure)))

(define (closure-body closure)
  (car (cdr (cdr closure))))

(define (closure-environment closure)
  (car (cdr (cdr (cdr closure)))))

(define (evaluate-sequence expressions environment)
  (if (null? expressions)
      '()
      (let ((result (evaluate (car expressions) environment)))
        (if (null? (cdr expressions))
            result
            (evaluate-sequence (cdr expressions) environment)))))

(define (evaluate-list expressions environment)
  (if (null? expressions)
      '()
      (cons (evaluate (car expressions) environment)
            (evaluate-list (cdr expressions) environment))))

(define (bind-parameters parameters arguments environment)
  (if (null? parameters)
      '()
      (begin
        (environment-define! environment
                              (car parameters)
                              (car arguments))
        (bind-parameters (cdr parameters)
                         (cdr arguments)
                         environment))))

(define (evaluate-bindings bindings outer-environment new-environment)
  (if (null? bindings)
      '()
      (begin
        (let ((binding (car bindings)))
          (environment-define! new-environment
                                (car binding)
                                (evaluate (car (cdr binding))
                                          outer-environment)))
        (evaluate-bindings (cdr bindings)
                           outer-environment
                           new-environment))))

(define (apply-closure closure arguments)
  (let ((new-environment
         (make-environment (closure-environment closure))))

                     arguments
                     new-environment)
    (evaluate-sequence (closure-body closure) new-environment)))

  (car (cdr (cdr arguments))))

  (if (null? arguments)
      0
      (+ (car arguments) (primitive-sum (cdr arguments)))))

(define (primitive-product arguments)
  (if (null? arguments)
      1

(define (primitive-and arguments)
  (if (null? arguments)
      #t

(define (primitive-or arguments)
  (if (null? arguments)
      #f

          #t)))

  (cond
    ((eq? primitive '+) (primitive-sum arguments))
    ((eq? primitive '-)

    ((eq? primitive '<)

    ((eq? primitive '>)

    ((eq? primitive '<=)

    ((eq? primitive '>=)

    ((string? expression) expression)

    ((not (pair? expression)) expression)

                   environment
                   (car target)

                                 (cdr (cdr expression))
                                 environment))

                (begin
                  (environment-define!
                   environment
                   target
                   (evaluate (car (cdr (cdr expression))) environment))
                  '()))))

          (begin

                              (car (cdr expression))
                              (evaluate (car (cdr (cdr expression)))

                        (cdr (cdr expression))

    (if (not file)

- Added association-list environments with lexical scoping and mutation support (`eval.scm:5`).

- Reads one path from stdin, interprets the file via `fread`, and preserves remaining stdin for the interpreted program (`eval.scm:319`).
